prompts.prompt: Use case: product-mockup. Create a premium photorealistic Happy Spoon product campaign image designed for a circular website display. The provided image is the EXACT product reference. Preserve its 32 oz tub silhouette, proportions, label design, HAPPY SPOON wordmark, smile, all lettering, flavor name, label colors, illustrations and especially the flat crinkled aluminum foil seal. No rigid plastic lid. One tub only, closed. Recompose the tub at center with a subtle 7-degree counterclockwise lean, readable front label, foil lid visible at same reference camera angle. Tub occupies 66 percent of square canvas height. Place three broken dark chocolate chunks with crisp fractured edges as two restrained floating clusters near the lower left and upper right sides of tub, framing the product, never covering the main logo or flavor name. Crisp premium studio photography, realistic texture, soft directional highlights and a gentle small shadow under floating tub. Square composition, entire tub and all ingredients fully inside an imaginary centered circle of diameter 86 percent of canvas, with generous empty space in square corners so circular cropping cuts off NOTHING. High visual clarity at 440px display size. No podium, no brownie platform, no plate, no milk splashes, no syrup ribbons, no scenery, no extra text, no badges, no graphic borders, no hazy edges, no blur around cutout. The product is the hero. Match the exact packaging reference.
